items.title: AI: Chat
items.description: Generate text from a prompt or explicit messages.

items.title: AI: Visual object localization
items.description: Estimate the locations of visible objects described in an image and return normalized bounding boxes. Results may omit or mislocalize objects.
items.syntax:
const image = await tobub.atoms.screenshot({ output: 'base64', type: 'jpeg', quality: 65 });
const result = await tobub.ai.locateObjects({ input: image, description: 'Baidu Map shop POI icon bodies' });

demos.code:
const image = await tobub.atoms.screenshot({ output: 'base64', type: 'jpeg', quality: 65 });
const result = await tobub.ai.locateObjects({ input: image, description: 'Baidu Map shop POI icon bodies' });

const target = result.objects[0];
if (target) { const box = target.bounds; await tobub.atoms.clickAt({ x: (box.x + box.width / 2) * image.width, y: (box.y + box.height / 2) * image.height }); }
demos.description: Convert one estimated box center to viewport coordinates

items.title: AI: Image OCR
items.description: Recognize visible text in an image and return normalized text bounding boxes. Coordinates are model estimates, not calibrated detections.
items.syntax:
const image = await tobub.atoms.screenshot({ output: 'base64', type: 'jpeg', quality: 65 });
const result = await tobub.ai.ocr({ input: image, language: 'zh-CN' });

demos.code:
const image = await tobub.atoms.screenshot({ output: 'base64', type: 'jpeg', quality: 65 });
const result = await tobub.ai.ocr({ input: image, language: 'zh-CN' });
demos.description: Recognize text in the current viewport

demos.code:
const box = result.blocks[0]?.bounds;
if (box) await tobub.atoms.clickAt({ x: (box.x + box.width / 2) * image.width, y: (box.y + box.height / 2) * image.height });
demos.description: Click the center of recognized text

items.title: Extract one item
items.description: Extract one structured record from the first element matching a CSS selector. Fields share one JSON contract: use transforms for cleanup and regex extraction, fields for nested objects, many for arrays, and parse for typed values.

demos.code: const item = await tobub.atoms.extractItem({ selector: '.product', fields: [{ name: 'title', selector: '.title', transforms: [{ type: 'trim' }] }, { name: 'url', selector: 'a', source: 'href' }] });
demos.description: Extract cleaned text and an href from one item.

demos.code: const item = await tobub.atoms.extractItem({ selector: '.product', fields: [{ name: 'title', selector: '.title' }, { name: 'price', selector: '.price', parse: 'number' }, { name: 'seller', selector: '.seller', fields: [{ name: 'name' }, { name: 'badgeCount', selector: '.badge', source: 'count' }] }] });
demos.description: Build a nested object and convert a numeric field without custom JavaScript.

demos.code: const item = await tobub.atoms.extractItem({ selector: '.profile', fields: [{ name: 'userId', selector: 'a.profile-link', source: 'href', transforms: [{ type: 'match', pattern: { pattern: '/user/(\\d+)' } }] }, { name: 'avatar', selector: 'img', source: 'src', transforms: [{ type: 'absoluteUrl', baseUrl: 'https://example.com' }] }] });
demos.description: Extract a capture group from a URL and normalize another URL to an absolute URL.

items.title: Extract a list
items.description: Extract records from repeated DOM items with the same JSON FieldSpec used by Rules and DOM observation. Use filter for declarative post-extraction filtering before records are returned, and read filteredCount for diagnostics.

demos.code: const result = await tobub.atoms.extractList({ itemSelector: '.product', fields: [{ name: 'title', selector: '.title', transforms: [{ type: 'trim' }] }], maxItems: 20 });
demos.description: Extract up to twenty repeated items with normalized titles.

demos.code: const result = await tobub.atoms.extractList({ itemSelector: '.product', fields: [{ name: 'title', selector: '.title' }, { name: 'price', selector: '.price', parse: 'number' }], filter: { path: 'price', op: 'gte', value: 100 }, maxItems: 50 });
demos.description: Parse a number and keep only records meeting a declarative threshold.

demos.code: const result = await tobub.atoms.extractList({ itemSelector: '.post', fields: [{ name: 'title', selector: '.title' }, { name: 'tags', selector: '.tag', many: true }], filter: { path: 'tags', op: 'some', filter: { path: '', op: 'eq', value: 'AI', caseSensitive: false } }, errorPolicy: 'skip' });
demos.description: Return repeated child values as an array and filter with an array quantifier.
